subject: What are my API rate limits?
body: I'm building an integration and want to know how many requests per minute my plan allows.
notes: Pro limit (600 req/min) is documented in api.md; a direct answer is expected.

subject: Refund for yesterday's charge
body: I was charged for my monthly Pro subscription yesterday but meant to cancel. Can I get a refund?
notes: billing.md explicitly says refunds must be handled by a human billing agent.

subject: Can't remember my password
body: I forgot my password and can't log in. Can you reset it for me?
notes: account.md documents self-service reset at lanekeep.com/reset; support cannot set passwords.

subject: Locked out - lost authenticator and recovery codes
body: My phone died and I don't have my recovery codes. I'm completely locked out of our workspace and we have a launch tomorrow.
notes: account.md: lost 2FA + recovery codes requires human identity verification, escalate priority high. Enterprise customer.

subject: Webhooks not available?
body: I can't find webhook settings anywhere. How do I set up webhooks on my account?
notes: api.md: webhooks are Enterprise-only. Correct reply explains this; upgrading is optional to mention.

subject: How much is Pro?
body: We're outgrowing the free plan. What does Pro cost and what do we get?

subject: Will downgrading delete my projects?
body: If I downgrade from Pro to Free but have 10 projects, do I lose the extra ones?
notes: billing.md: excess projects are locked read-only, not deleted.

subject: Where do I configure SAML SSO?
body: We're rolling out Okta and need to set up SAML for our workspace.
notes: account.md documents SSO config location and the workspace-owner requirement.

subject: Export all our data
body: For compliance we need a full export of our workspace data. How do I get it?
notes: account.md: admins self-serve export from Settings > Workspace > Export.

subject: API key suddenly stopped working
body: All our API calls return 401 since this morning. We were hammering the API pretty hard over the weekend. Was our key suspended? Can you restore it?
notes: api.md says sustained over-limit use may suspend a key; restoring one is not something the agent can do.

subject: Salesforce integration?
body: Does Lanekeep integrate with Salesforce? We need two-way sync of tasks against opportunities.
notes: Not covered anywhere in the docs; answering either way would invent product facts.

subject: What uptime do you guarantee?
body: Our procurement team is asking what SLA we have on our current plan.
notes: billing.md: Enterprise has a 99.9% uptime SLA, and this customer is on Enterprise.
